messages:
Elena Park: Heads-up: micro-launch webinar Thurs 9am PT. Need a lean reg page, Zoom runbook, and a tight post-event sequence. Can we assign owners?
Omar Reyes: I can do the reg page. Proposal: single-field email, optional company, hidden utm params, GDPR checkbox, and a tiny CTA to request clips. Need short hero and one-sentence blurb.
Priya Singh: Uploading copy now. Will include short privacy hovertext and a transcript opt-in checkbox.
Sam Cho: Zoom ops plan: cloud recording (active speaker + shared screen), separate audio tracks, SRT export enabled, two alternative hosts. Will set co-host auto-assign. Any other asks?
Jenna Liu: Please enable live captions and make sure SRT export is available. Ill QA captions during runthrough and tag clip owners after upload.
Tom Ruiz: Lead routing: HubSpot form endpoint. Map utm_source -> original_source, utm_campaign -> campaign. Trigger: form submit. Actions: create contact, set lifecycle_stage=lead, add to list "MicroLaunch-Regs", send immediate confirmation. Post-event: attendees -> tag "attended" + send replay @24h; no-shows -> 48h drip with 3 short clips.
Omar Reyes: Question: show calendar .ics on confirmation page and in email?
Elena Park: Yes, include .ics and calendar link. Also add one-line survey (1 question) in confirmation email to capture topic interest.
Sam Cho: Contingency plan: local host recording + RTMP fallback if cloud fails. Ill bring spare laptop to runthrough.
event-bot: Event created: "Micro Launch: Inference at the Edge"  Thu 9:00am PT  Zoom link added.
Elena Park: Action recap: Omar = reg page + test, Priya = copy + confirmation email, Sam = Zoom config + runthrough, Jenna = captions + SRT handoff, Tom = HubSpot workflow + post-event sequences. Quick check-in tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
Omar Reyes: Running a test submit now and will post results here. :mag:
